messages.subject: Project — Heads of Terms for signature
messages.plaintextBody:
Rebecca,

Attached are the Heads of Terms (subject to contract). Key binding points are confidentiality, a 60-day exclusivity period and costs. On liability we've put the opening position at 100% of trailing 12 months' charges — expect Stratton to push for more.

Happy for you to sign and send to Robert Pearce at Stratton.

Best,
James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
